cells.gaps: The 30% is a share of all health facilities with no numerator or denominator, and the tier of the facilities keying their own reports is not stated; the two 2025 facts on where data is keyed disagree (SSD-015 facility, SSD-016 centralised at a level it does not name), and SSD-011 says the PHCC and PHCU vouchers are configured, not where they are keyed. On the plan, the HSSP 2023-2027 targets for DHIS2 (SSD-019) stand against a February 2025 self-assessment that lists an HIS strategic plan as still to be established (SSD-008).
cells.note: The Ministry of Health puts facilities entering their own reports in DHIS2 at 30% in 2025, a minority, with entry elsewhere centralised above the facility, which is stage 3's row. Stage 4 needs more than half of primary clinics entering their own reports.
cells.parent: Parent, 2026-10-07: digitised takes one value; entry above the facility is the general route, 30% of facilities key their own.

cells.gaps: The one EMR row, SSD-005, is from the excluded source and sets nothing, so neither a system in use nor a dated statement of paper records at every tier is held. systems.csv holds only a noted class, the OpenMRS ART E-register at five sites (tracker), plus an unnamed and unclassified 22.4% of facilities with facility-wide electronic systems.
cells.note: No admissible row sets a rung, and stage 1 needs a dated statement of absence that only the excluded source gives. The country holds only a noted class on this sub-indicator.
